structural_limit: the 100 KB criterion is UNREACHABLE in this architecture: the vocabulary dictionary alone is 690.6 KB, so even a zero-size SVD matrix fails the criterion. All three compression paths target the SVD matrix, i.e. the wrong component.
implication: a sub-100 KB encoder requires a DICTIONARY-FREE architecture. The 44 KB estimate in the proposal counted only the prototype table; the word-to-prototype map itself is the dominant cost.
caveat: measured as live Python objects; a C/Rust implementation would store the vocabulary far more compactly, so this limit is implementation-dependent
